meta.name: ai-music-generation
meta.description: Generate AI music and songs with Diffrythm, Tencent Song Generation via inference.sh CLI. Models: Diffrythm (fast song generation), Tencent Song Generation (full songs with vocals). Capabilities: text-to-music, song generation, instrumental, lyrics to song, soundtrack creation. Use for: background music, social media content, game soundtracks, podcasts, royalty-free music. Triggers: music generation, ai music, generate song, ai composer, text to music, song generator, create music with ai, suno alternative, udio alternative, ai song, ai soundtrack, generate soundtrack, ai jingle, music ai, beat generator

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入文字或歌词，生成歌曲与配乐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为视频或播客配原创音乐
copy.tagline_en: Turn text or lyrics into AI-generated songs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need original music for videos or podcasts

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据你的文字描述直接生成音乐或歌曲,比如器乐、带人声的歌曲、配乐等。它会使用两个 AI 模型来产出音频。
howto.when: 当你说出“生成音乐”“AI 音乐”“生成歌曲”等指令,或要求为视频、播客、游戏做背景音乐时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一首欢快的电子舞曲。
say.note: Claude 会用 Diffrythm 生成器乐。

say.text: 用 Tencent Song 生成一首关于夏日爱情的流行歌。
say.note: 可附带歌词,否则模型按主题生成。

say.text: 做一首 10 秒的播客片头音乐,科技主题。
say.note: Claude 会按指定时长和风格生成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate music or songs from text descriptions, including instrumentals, vocal tracks, and soundtracks. It uses two AI models to produce audio.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says commands like "generate music", "AI music", or "generate song", or asks for background music for videos, podcasts, or games.

say_en.text: Generate a happy electronic dance track.
say_en.note: Claude uses Diffrythm for an instrumental.

say_en.text: Use Tencent Song to create a pop song about summer love.
say_en.note: You can provide lyrics; otherwise model follows the theme.

say_en.text: Make a 10-second podcast intro with a tech theme.
say_en.note: Claude generates audio with the specified length and style.
